body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a temporary override flag, `--allow-self-hosted-pr`, to the security check script `check_no_self_hosted_pull_request.py`. This flag allows PR-like workflows to run on self-hosted runners while continuing to block production-like secrets. Corresponding unit and integration tests have been added and updated to verify this behavior. The reviewer raised a high-severity security concern regarding the execution of untrusted fork PRs on self-hosted runners, recommending strict approval settings and sandboxing to mitigate arbitrary code execution risks.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
